decisions.reason: Restricting the colors offered as palette options does not change the prescribed green level-9 bullet or the bullet size, alignment, appearance, and scaling rules.
The color-option policy does not change Board Meeting field alignment.
The color-option policy does not affect row insertion or unintended border behavior.
The date-selection control and its template coverage remain unchanged by the palette restriction.
Restricting available color options does not alter placeholder clearing behavior or its scope.
The palette decision does not change text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The Guidance template margin and pencil-icon visibility requirements are independent of the color palette.
The color-option policy does not affect multiline entry or use of standard Enter.
The palette restriction does not change hard-return spacing for continuous text.

The requirement to implement the specified style catalog across the template set remains valid; limiting user-facing color options does not necessarily change catalog coverage or its source style system.
The palette restriction does not change the NXQ style prefix, its application condition, or Danish style naming.
The image and table caption typography and style name are unaffected by the number of color options offered.
